title: Yellow Peppery Malaysian Cheese Sandwich
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Malaysian dish featuring rye bread, steam, and a blend of cheeses, this sandwich is perfect for adventurous eaters, with a peppery flavor and cheese-pull texture. It is a unique twist on traditional sandwiches.
instructions: Butter one side of each slice of rye bread.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Place two slices of bread, buttered side down, in the skillet.
Top each bread slice with a slice of yellow pepper, a sprinkle of salt, and a sprinkle of black pepper.
Divide the malaysian pepper cheese and monterey jack cheese evenly between the two bread slices.
Place the other two slices of bread, buttered side up, on top of the cheese.
Pour in the water and cover the skillet with a lid.
Steam the sandwich for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
Flip the sandwich over and steam for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the sandwich from the skillet and let it cool for 1 minute before serving.
